body.name: \mathcal C_n(\alpha)
body.construction: Conditional on \(N_{xz}\), let \(I_{xzay,n}(\alpha)\) be the two-sided Clopper--Pearson interval at error \(\alpha/(2K|\mathcal X||\mathcal Z|)\) for \(N_{xzay}\) out of \(N_{xz}\), with \(I_{xzay,n}(\alpha)=[0,1]\) when \(N_{xz}=0\). Then \(\mathcal C_n(\alpha)\) is the set of collections \(p=(p_x)_{x\in\mathcal X}\) whose cells lie in all these intervals, whose rows lie in their multinomial simplices, and for which \(\mathcal W_x(p_x)\neq\varnothing\) for every \(x\).
